from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=0)
    mark=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==mark]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for dr in range(h-mh+1):
        for dc in range(w-mw+1):
            cells=[(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in shape]
            if all(g[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=mark
    return g

for name,grid,expected in [('demo1',A,B),('demo2',C,D),('demo3',E,F)]:
 pred=transform(grid)
 mismatches=[(i,j,pred[i][j],expected[i][j]) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if pred[i][j]!=expected[i][j]]
 print(name,'mismatches',len(mismatches),mismatches[:10])

prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Recolor translated copies of the marked shape in zero cells."""
    src = grid
    out = [row[:] for row in src]
    h, w = len(src), len(src[0])

    counts = Counter(value for row in src for value in row if value != 0)
    mark = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(src) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == mark]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1

    # Test every same-orientation translation against the unchanged input.
    for dr in range(h - sh + 1):
        for dc in range(w - sw + 1):
            cells = [(dr + r, dc + c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(src[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = mark
    return out
'''
